security_audit.summary: The shell-execution and system-reconnaissance matches are false positives caused by Markdown examples and design wording in SKILL.md. No evidence found for prompt injection, credential access, data exfiltration, or host reconnaissance intent.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the Picsum URL instruction with user-approved assets, local project assets, or an explicit opt-in for external images.
Clarify that the Python randomization step is only a written planning simulation and must not run host commands.

content.value_statement: Generic AI landing pages often repeat narrow heroes, weak grids, and static layouts. GPT Taste gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a stricter brief for editorial layouts, GSAP motion, bento grids, and asset usage.
actual_capabilities: Guides page structure with navigation, hero, feature, desire, and action sections.
Requires a design plan before UI code with layout, font, motion, and grid checks.
Directs GSAP ScrollTrigger use for pinning, scrubbed reveals, scaling, fading, and stacked cards.
Specifies wide hero typography, high contrast buttons, and removal of generic meta labels.
Recommends gapless Tailwind bento grids with dense flow and span verification.
Suggests external seeded image URLs and CSS filters for visual texture.
limitations: Provides instructions only and does not include runnable components or project files.
Depends on the host model to follow visual checks accurately.
Can encourage external image loading from Picsum unless the user replaces it.
Its strict style rules may be too opinionated for conservative brand systems.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Landing Page

prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Taste to create a premium landing page for a productivity app. Include a hero, feature section, motion section, and final call to action.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use GPT Taste to design a React page with pinned GSAP sections, scrubbed text reveals, hover physics, and a gapless bento feature grid.

prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a detailed implementation brief.

output_examples.input: Create a landing page for an AI scheduling product.
output_examples.output: A structured design plan followed by a premium page concept with a wide hero, two clear calls to action, dense feature grid, pinned motion section, and strong footer.

output_examples.input: Improve a portfolio homepage that feels generic.
output_examples.output: A more editorial layout with larger typography, fewer but stronger content blocks, inline imagery, hover motion, and removal of generic section labels.

output_examples.input: Build a motion-heavy product page in React.
output_examples.output: A React-oriented page direction that includes GSAP ScrollTrigger behaviors, image scaling, scrubbed reveals, card stacking, and overflow protection.

best_practices: Replace placeholder image sources with approved brand assets before production use.
Review the generated design plan before accepting the final UI code.
Test motion, overflow, contrast, and responsive wrapping on mobile and desktop.
anti_patterns: Do not use it for conservative internal tools that require dense, quiet interfaces.
Do not publish generated external image URLs without privacy and licensing review.
Do not accept the simulated planning step as proof that the layout was actually tested.

faq.question: Does this skill run Python?
faq.answer: No. It asks the model to write a deterministic planning simulation before generating UI.

faq.question: Does it require GSAP?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed around GSAP motion patterns and ScrollTrigger behavior.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it suitable for dashboards?
faq.answer: It is better for expressive landing pages than dense operational dashboards.

faq.question: Does it include ready-made components?
faq.answer: No. It provides instructions that guide an AI tool to generate components.

faq.question: What should I review before production?
faq.answer: Review external image sources, animation performance, accessibility, responsive layout, and brand fit.
